layout.title: Your sessions
layout.lead: Prepare joining details, record attendance and follow your learners' progress.

noProfile.title: No instructor profile on this account
noProfile.body: This area lists the sessions assigned to an instructor profile. Your account is not linked to one, so there is nothing to show here.

list.emptyBody: When the academy assigns you to a session, it will appear here.
list.noPast: You have no past sessions yet.

join.title: Joining details
join.body: Learners see these details in their own account once they are enrolled. They are never shown publicly.
join.missing: No meeting link has been added yet. Learners cannot join until you add one.
join.urlHint: Create the meeting in Teams or Zoom, then paste its link here. The link must start with https://
join.instructionsHint: For example: join five minutes early and keep your camera on.

attendance.title: Attendance and progress
attendance.notice: You record each learner's attendance yourself; nothing is tracked automatically. A learner needs at least {min}% attendance on this course to take the exam. Every entry and every correction is kept in an audit trail.
attendance.notStartedTitle: The session has not started yet
attendance.notStarted: Attendance can be recorded once the session has started. The forms below are disabled until then.
attendance.caption: Learners enrolled in this session
attendance.emptyBody: Learners will appear here as soon as they are enrolled in this session.
